_what_this_is: Values and quoted text taken from the source publications. NOT in the repository: the corpus is not redistributable, so this file is yours to write. Every key below is required; the values here are invented.
_how_to_use: Copy to study_inputs.json beside the scripts, or point FDT_STUDY_INPUTS at your own path.
_provenance_rule: Each figure_rows entry should be checked against the rendered source page before it is written, not copied from a routing queue. A queue is a plan; the page is the evidence.

figure_rows.discrepancy_flag: yes  # set when the figure disagrees with itself, e.g. column header vs axis label

figure_pending.why_not_extracted: Why these printed values were NOT made effect rows. An unstated comparator belongs here: the number is real but the contrast it expresses is unknown, and a guessed comparator is worse than a held value.

adjustment_text.REC_ID: the covariate sentence as the paper's own footnote prints it

stratum_headers.Printed heading in the supplement table: the label this pipeline uses for it
